correctness.rationale: For every 0<p<1, 0<t<=1 and integer k>=2, the infinite process is constructed by a summable decreasing-priority dependency path. The half-line endpoint probabilities obey a linear ODE a'=p(1-b), b'=q(1-a) and yield a=H_p. Conditioning on A proposals inside a k-block shows the interiors always succeed, and independent outside half-lines give Q_k=H_p^2(pt)^(k-2). Two-sided inclusion-exclusion produces lambda_k; sums converge because pt<1; a two-sided boundary integral yields the singleton. A separate rational-arithmetic enumeration tests 270 finite-path joint probabilities, the finite-halfline recurrences, the truncation bound and normalization, for a reported 360 assertions. Computational checks are finite and do not substitute for the analytic proof.

value.rationale: For irreversible two-color lattice growth, run-length morphology is a directly motivated observable: the occupied density alone cannot quantify cluster fragmentation or tail shape. The theorem gives the full exact length-resolved intensity family for all times and species biases, a sharp shifted geometric law beyond singleton clusters, an explicit singleton correction and mean cluster length. These quantify a natural structural observable and provide independently checkable higher-order benchmarks for adsorption, rather than a cosmetic numerical recomputation.
